thread:
emily: heads-up — when I open the per-route view with model telemetry enabled I see cold-load times jump from ~400ms to ~1.6s. noticed this on prod and staging. anyone else seeing the same?

jordan: yup, saw that yesterday. looks like the console is hitting /api/route/summary and then n separate /api/model/stats calls for pinned models. two roundtrips + join on the client.

tariq: quick thought: combine those into a single prefetch/aggregate endpoint that returns route summary + model telemetry in one response. trades some backend work for fewer client RTTs.

emily: agree that's the obvious optimization. UX question: should we prefetch by default for every saved view? or gate it behind a toggle/preview? cost/quotas worry me.

mai: could we make it opt-in per-saved-query? e.g. a small "Load detailed telemetry" checkbox on saved views. default off for free/low-tier orgs. show inline cost hint. :money_with_wings:

jordan: API sketch: 
```
GET /api/console/route_view?route_id=abc&prefetch=combined&telemetry_sample=0.2
Response: { route_summary: { ... }, models: [{ id, stats: { qps, p50_latency, sample_rate: 0.2 } }, ...], telemetry_sample_rate: 0.2 }
```

tariq: prefer explicit prefetch_scope param: prefetch_scope=none|route|models|all. and add max_age_secs to allow CDN/cache hints (eg max_age=30). that way we can tune freshness vs cost.

console-bot: perf-test update: staging run with combined endpoint reduces median console load from 1.6s -> 420ms, p95 from 3.1s -> 900ms. (run id: console-prefetch-2026-03-18) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

emily: nice numbers. still need to handle org-level telemetry quotas. if a customer has tight telemetry sampling quotas, prefetch should automatically degrade to route-only or sampled models and surface that to the user.

mai: UX copy suggestion: "Detailed telemetry (may increase telemetry usage and cost)." Tooltip: "Enabling this fetches per-model metrics for this view; we may sample or fallback if your org quota is constrained." show a small cost-estimate inline: "~+0.6s cost / view" (just an example).

jordan: on the API side we should return a small metadata block: {prefetch_scope_returned, telemetry_sample_rate_used, quota_status}. client can then render accurate messaging/toasts.

tariq: ops ask: add telemetry-metering tag on these combined calls so billing can associate per-view costs. also emit a meter event when fallback happens.

emily: good. owners? i can write the ticket for fallback UX and telemetry copy. @jordan take API PR? @tariq prototype the combined endpoint? @mai mock the checkbox + tooltip in figma?

jordan: i'll take the API PR, will post draft by EOD tomorrow.

tariq: i'll spin up a prototype in staging this week, will link test results.

mai: i'll add a tiny mock + suggested microcopy, and add a line to the saved-query schema to persist the prefetch preference.

emily: perfect. i'll file the umbrella ticket with acceptance criteria: 1) combined endpoint exists, 2) client persists prefetch preference in saved-views, 3) UX shows cost/quota hint, 4) fallback path implemented + meters.

console-bot: ci: /staging/integration/console-prefetch passed. commit: a1b2c3d.

emily: thanks all. we'll reconvene after initial PRs. :raised_hands:

end of thread
